product_overview: Apothecary is a herbal wellness platform with an AI nutritionist, semantic herb search, and recipe discovery features. It serves a web experience for conversational guidance and search, powered by Supabase Edge Functions, OpenAI, and pgvector.
core_goals: Provide conversational nutrition guidance through an AI assistant with streamed responses
Enable fast semantic search across herbs using natural-language queries
Allow users to discover both herbs and community recipes from one search experience
Support safe, validated backend interactions with clear error handling and CORS compatibility

features.name: AI Nutritionist Chat (SSE)
features.description: A streaming conversational assistant that accepts message history, triggers herb search as needed, and returns incremental AI output over Server-Sent Events.
user_flows: POST /nutritionist with a valid JSON body containing one user message -> Receive 200 text/event-stream with tool_use event -> Receive herb_results event with matching herbs -> Receive text_delta events as the assistant composes a response -> Receive done event
POST /nutritionist with invalid JSON body -> Receive 400 with {"error":"Invalid JSON body"}
POST /nutritionist with messages array exceeding 50 entries or last message not from user -> Receive 400 with a validation error message
GET /nutritionist or any non-POST method -> Receive 405 with {"error":"Method not allowed"}

features.name: Herb Semantic Search
features.description: A natural-language herb search endpoint that embeds the query, matches against herb vectors, and returns ranked herb results above the similarity threshold.
user_flows: POST /search with a non-empty query and optional numeric limit -> Receive 200 with ranked herb results sorted by similarity descending and limited to the requested count
POST /search with query set to an empty string or missing -> Receive 400 with {"error":"query is required and must be a string"}
POST /search with limit provided as a string or outside 1-50 -> Receive 400 with {"error":"limit must be a number between 1 and 50"}
OPTIONS /search from an allowed Origin -> Receive 200 with CORS headers echoing the Origin and Allow-Methods including POST

features.name: Combined Herb and Recipe Search
features.description: A unified search endpoint that embeds the user query once and returns matching herbs and recipes in parallel, with recipes allowed to be empty when no community recipes match.
user_flows: POST /recipes-search with a valid query and optional limit -> Receive 200 with both herbs and recipes arrays present in the response
POST /recipes-search with a query like 'help me sleep' -> Receive 200 with matching herbs and possibly an empty recipes array
POST /recipes-search with missing query or invalid limit -> Receive 400 with a validation error message
POST /recipes-search with a request that yields no recipe matches -> Receive 200 with an empty recipes array and non-empty herbs array when herb matches exist

features.name: Herb Semantic Search
features.description: Embeds the query (prefixed with "Herb for "), runs pgvector cosine similarity via the match_herbs RPC with threshold 0.3, and returns ranked herbs. Base URL is http://localhost:54321/functions/v1. Served locally with --no-verify-jwt, so no auth header is required. Validation errors return 400 with body {"error": "<message>"}. OPTIONS returns CORS headers; Origin https://herbary.app and http://localhost:5173 are echoed back.

endpoints.description: Semantic herb search. query is required, a non-empty string of at most 500 characters. limit is optional, a JSON number from 1 to 50, default 8 (strings such as "5" are rejected). Results are sorted by similarity descending, every similarity is >= 0.3, and the count is <= limit. A query like "help me sleep" returns herbs such as Valerian Root.

response_schema.200: { results: [{ id: number, name: string, description: string, how_to_use: string, category: string[], tags: string[], energetics: string[], botanical_name: string, plant_part: string, origin: string, form: string, similarity: number }] }
response_schema.400: { error: string } e.g. 'query is required and must be a string', 'query must be 500 characters or less', 'limit must be a number between 1 and 50'

endpoints.description: CORS preflight; returns 200 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin echoing an allowed Origin and Access-Control-Allow-Methods including POST.

features.name: Combined Herb and Recipe Search
features.description: One embedding of the raw query (no "Herb for " stem), then match_herbs and match_recipes in parallel. The recipes list may legitimately be empty because no community recipes exist yet. Uses the same validation as /search.

endpoints.description: Returns both herbs and recipes matching the query. Same query/limit validation as /search.

response_schema.200: { herbs: Herb[], recipes: [{ id, name, ingredients, instructions, prep_time, photo_url, similarity, ... }] } — both keys always present as arrays; recipes may be empty

features.name: AI Nutritionist Chat (SSE)
features.description:
Agentic chat over Server-Sent Events. The request is validated before any rate limiting or model call. Rate limiting is disabled locally (APOTHECARY_ENV=development). A valid request streams Content-Type text/event-stream with events of the form "event: <name>
data: <json>

". Event names are tool_use {name, input}, herb_results {herbs}, text_delta {delta}, done {}, error {message}. The first user turn always triggers a herb_search tool call, so the stream contains a tool_use event, a herb_results event, text_delta events and ends with done. A full answer can take 20-60 seconds; use a generous read timeout (120s).

endpoints.description: Chat request. messages must be a non-empty array of at most 50 items; each item has role 'user' or 'assistant' and string content; user content must be 1-4000 characters; the last message must have role 'user'. Non-POST methods return 405 with {"error":"Method not allowed"}. A body that is not valid JSON returns 400 with {"error":"Invalid JSON body"}.

body.messages: [{ role: 'user' | 'assistant', content: string }] (1-50 items, last must be user)

response_schema.200: text/event-stream of tool_use, herb_results, text_delta, done (or error) events
response_schema.400: { error: string } e.g. 'messages must be a non-empty array', 'messages cannot exceed 50 entries', 'message role must be ''user'' or ''assistant''', 'user message content must be non-empty', 'user message content exceeds 4000 characters', 'last message must have role ''user'''
response_schema.429: { error: 'rate_limit', retry_after_seconds } with Retry-After header (production only; disabled locally)

known_limitations.issue: The recipes CRUD function (/recipes) requires a signed-in user JWT, and user accounts are not live yet. It is out of scope for testing.
/search has no rate limit and each call costs one OpenAI embedding.
Nutritionist calls cost OpenAI tokens and take up to a minute.
known_limitations.impact: Keep to one successful streaming test; cover everything else with validation-only requests.
